answer_4.quote: We selected 32 crowd‑workers from Prolific who are native English speakers and work in education. ... Our evaluation consists of close‑ended (limited number of answers) questions that pertain to both the local (subsection) and global (section) textual context ... Local evaluation: • Is this image relevant to educational concepts described in this subsection text? • Is this image redundant compared to previous images in this subsection? • What is the type of this image? • Is this image didactically useful for explaining this section text?
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer a set of predefined questions about each image, covering relevance, redundancy, type, and didactic usefulness at both the local (subsection) and global (section) level.
